mapper.select: SELECT AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS total_sessions, SUM(CASE WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS labeled_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL AND () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_positive, SUM(CASE WHEN o.event_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_negative, SUM(CASE WHEN es.status = 'BLOCKED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS blocked_count FROM evaluation_session es LEFT JOIN decision_outcome o ON o.tenant_id = es.tenant_id AND o.event_id = es.event_id WHERE es.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND es.scene_code = #{sceneCode} AND es.occurred_at >= #{from} AND es.occurred_at < #{to} GROUP BY bucket
